name: Training Grounds
desc1: You are at the intersection of two dimly lit corridors. To the north,
desc2: you notice it seems to get darker. Symbols of battle and war decorate
desc3: the walls, hand-drawn in the blood of victims. Sounds of combat echo
desc4: the halls, leaving you to wonder which direction they come from.
desc5: You feel a soft breeze from the western wall.
